# ComposeDoc

Multilingual WYSIWYG document editing for Compose Multiplatform.
Package/group: dev.shayxo.composedoc. GitHub development only; no package release.

## Start here
- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md)
- [Claude entry](CLAUDE.md)
- [Documentation index](docs/README.md)
- [Owner mission and decisions](docs/project/PROJECT-JOURNAL.md)

- [Migration checkpoint](docs/reports/composedoc-migration-progress.md)
- [Contribution policy](CONTRIBUTING.md)

## Source
- core/model: immutable common document values and Unicode
- core/domain: authoritative commands/history and ports
- core/data: codecs, stores, recovery and resource IO
- core/layout: typography and page/output geometry
- core/ui: reusable state, rendering and platform input
- apps/desktop-workspace: example writing workspace
- tests/desktop-harness: executable desktop qualification commands

## Verification
- python tooling/docs/validate_docs.py
- node tooling/verification/v6.mjs
- ./gradlew check apiCheck
- python tooling/verification/test_verification.py
- python tooling/verification/verify.py --workspace-milestone

Synthetic evidence is not native platform qualification. See current reports.
